decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard through a combination of Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead spells. The key strategy is to fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty, then use spells like Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a quick win. The deck also includes disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and control the game until it can execute its game-winning combo.

This deck utilizes cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack to quickly put powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play, bypassing traditional mana costs. The deck also includes protection in the form of Force of Will and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo can go off smoothly. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine to provide additional value and support for the combo strategy. The overall goal is to cheat powerful creatures into play and overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing the card combination of Show and Tell and Sneak Attack to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to control the opponent's board while The One Ring provides additional support for the combo. The deck also includes mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, as well as disruption with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The goal is to quickly ramp up and overwhelm the opponent with big threats before they have a chance to respond.

This combo Reanimator deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. By utilizing cards like Animate Dead and Troll of Khazad-dûm, the deck is able to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a devastating advantage. With cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's board and disrupt their strategy, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. By using cheap interaction spells like Daze, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will, the deck aims to control the game tempo and maintain a board presence. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and filtering, while cards like Nihil Spellbomb help disrupt graveyard strategies. The deck also includes a selection of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats efficiently.

This deck aims to utilize the synergy between Mystic Forge, Voltaic Key, and Manifold Key to generate infinite colorless mana and cast spells for free from the top of the library. By repeatedly looping artifacts and tapping and untapping them, the deck can quickly assemble a powerful board state, including Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponent's artifacts. The combination of efficient mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Urza's Tower, along with powerful artifacts like Candelabra of Tawnos and Grim Monolith, allows the deck to efficiently execute its combo and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on using various creature tutors to assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game quickly. The key strategy revolves around rapidly ramping mana with cards like Noble Hierarch and Birds of Paradise, then using Natural Order or Green Sun's Zenith to search for powerful creatures like Nadu, Winged Wisdom or Craterhoof Behemoth. By efficiently tutoring for key pieces and generating significant amounts of mana with Gaea's Cradle, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and quickly close out the game.

The deck aims to cheat big creatures, such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, into play quickly by using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It also utilizes other cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine for additional synergy and protection. The deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Archon of Cruelty to control the board and disrupt opponents' plans. The deck is focused on using powerful combo pieces to overwhelm opponents and win the game quickly.

The main focus of this aggressive burn deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Chain Lightning. Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide additional pressure, while Eidolon of the Great Revel punishes opponents for playing spells. Price of Progress acts as a powerful finisher against non-basic land-heavy decks. The deck aims to win by dealing damage as quickly as possible, utilizing its burn spells and creatures to maintain a fast-paced and aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on maintaining tempo and control over the opponent's board through a combination of disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push, and land disruption with cards like Wasteland. The deck also aims to quickly deploy threats like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to pressure the opponent's life total and disrupt their game plan. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently navigating the game to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing cards that provide fast mana acceleration and disruptive elements to control the board. By ramping up quickly and locking down opponents' mana bases, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can establish their game plan. The creatures in the deck are mainly focused on dealing damage as quickly as possible, with some utility creatures thrown in for added versatility. Overall, the deck prioritizes speed and efficiency to gain the upper hand in the game.

The deck is built around quickly milling through your entire library to win the game in one turn by putting Thassa's Oracle onto the battlefield. The strategy revolves around using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to dump cards into the graveyard, while also utilizing cards like Dread Return and Reanimate to bring back key pieces like Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and ensure a swift victory.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy deck is to play aggressively and disrupt the opponent's mana base. By utilizing cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Sundering Eruption, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's lands and prevent them from casting spells effectively. The creatures in the deck, like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf, serve as threats that can quickly close out the game. Overall, the deck seeks to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this Combo - Mystic Forge Legacy deck is to generate infinite mana using cards like Basalt Monolith and Voltaic Key, along with powerful artifacts like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator to dig through the deck and cast spells for free. The deck also utilizes cards like Urza's Saga and Urza's Tower to ramp up mana production quickly. The win condition is to play The One Ring and assemble a combo with Glaring Fleshraker for a game-ending attack. The deck focuses on fast mana generation, artifact synergy, and powerful combo potential.

This deck revolves around utilizing Mystic Forge to play cards from the top of your library, primarily artifacts, to generate a powerful and versatile combo. It aims to ramp quickly with mana rocks like Grim Monolith and Urza's lands, while also using cards like Mox Opal and Voltaic Key to enable fast and explosive plays. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Karn, the Great Creator to control the game and protect its combo pieces. Overall, it is a high-risk, high-reward strategy that can lead to quick wins if executed effectively.

The key strategy of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom alongside Nomads en-Kor to draw through the deck quickly and find key pieces like Boseiju, Who Endures or Green Sun's Zenith. The deck includes control elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional utility and disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo while controlling the game to secure a victory.
